title: Polynomial separability is invariant under a coefficient-field map
statement: Let $K,L$ be fields [def-weil-field], let $\iota:K\to L$ be a unital field homomorphism, and let $p=\sum_i a_iX^i\in K[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Write $\iota_*p=\sum_i\iota(a_i)X^i\in L[X]$. Then $\iota_*p$ is separable [def-pc-separable-polynomial] if and only if $p$ is separable. No perfectness, algebraicity or finiteness of $L/K$ is assumed.
